test_title: PYST 39: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : PZL :: AKW : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : PZL :: AKW : %

**Option 1) # = HRD, % = LSE**

**For # (HRD) to PZL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b27e64aab3bf5c257103815e2b7827728212a7a5e44e34c05b479b4a8bcc4704.png] 

**For AKW to % (LSE)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c1cdb2d968d49dcf783e5fed8e31792235f4bf5c7662218d23209daa635aa56.png] 

 Option 1 is incorrect.

**Option 2) # = HRD, % = ISE**

**For # (HRD) to PZL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4dde31a08e894f618d2ebf3dda50d74ac6d19b6a424cb0b5d5a704bd6a911d9.png] 

**For AKW to % (ISE)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dc0e1299fd0182b8a674552e3bbd388de82098919ef7c69a39f16408412a321b.png] 

Option 2 is correct.

**Option 3) # = HRD, % = ISO**

**For # (HRD) to PZL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b4fbec4559f77a8b9742b238e19577a95afaed0c58d08b8736ac79b83a6695f.png] 

**For AKW to % (ISO)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ecbd792f5ca38626cf866db85a1ce84569234d7122c4f73a105dc9cd917bd82.png] 

Option 3 is incorrect.

**Option 4) # = URD, % = ISE**

**For # (URD) to PZL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3ca79b6113f770aeff597c477219f4180c89b25329fc1297f25a83097b1face.png] 

**For AKW to % (ISE)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67df2d58de7a902d2487f577f3085621fad09453d8e52c5722221932ff652697.png] 

 Option 4 is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
